classSweep.mechanism: ScreenIntro publishes screenHelp only from useEffect. HelpButton returns null while no help is registered. A unique visible About this screen after a full navigation/reload proves the screen committed on the client; SSR headings/input values alone do not.

sourceEvidence.detail: useEffect registers help after client commit
no registered help renders no button; mounted help gives About this screen
